<!-- Shared survey-loading logic. Included by index.qmd and region-data.qmd via {{< include _survey.qmd >}}.
     Files starting with "_" are not rendered as pages by Quarto. -->

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {SURVEYS, DEFAULT_SURVEY, surveyById} from "./assets/helpers.js"

// FileAttachment() needs literal paths so Quarto can copy the files into the site.
// To add a survey: add it to SURVEYS in assets/helpers.js AND add a block here.
surveyFiles = ({
  intl_2023: {
    scores:    FileAttachment("data/scores_intl_2023.csv"),
    inclusion: FileAttachment("data/inclusion_intl_2023.csv"),
    responses: FileAttachment("data/responses_intl_2023.csv"),
    questions: FileAttachment("data/questions_intl_2023.csv")
  },
  usa_2025: {
    scores:    FileAttachment("data/scores_usa_2025.csv"),
    inclusion: FileAttachment("data/inclusion_usa_2025.csv"),
    responses: FileAttachment("data/responses_usa_2025.csv"),
    questions: FileAttachment("data/questions_usa_2025.csv")
  },
  intl_2025: {
    scores:    FileAttachment("data/scores_intl_2025.csv"),
    inclusion: FileAttachment("data/inclusion_intl_2025.csv"),
    responses: FileAttachment("data/responses_intl_2025.csv"),
    questions: FileAttachment("data/questions_intl_2025.csv")
  }
})

// Initial survey: ?survey=... in the URL, else the last one picked (remembered across pages), else the default.
initialSurvey = {
  const fromUrl = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("survey");
  let fromStore = null;
  try { fromStore = sessionStorage.getItem("ds4s-survey"); } catch (e) {}
  return [fromUrl, fromStore].find(v => SURVEYS.some(s => s.id === v)) || DEFAULT_SURVEY;
}

// Each page defines its own `viewof surveyId` dropdown; this cell reacts to it.
survey = surveyById(surveyId)

persistSurvey = { try { sessionStorage.setItem("ds4s-survey", survey.id); } catch (e) {} }

// A missing/empty file yields [] / "" instead of breaking the page.
loadCsv  = async (file, opts) => { try { return await file.csv(opts); }  catch (e) { return []; } }
loadText = async (file)       => { try { return await file.text(); }     catch (e) { return ""; } }

scores    = loadCsv(surveyFiles[survey.id].scores,    {typed: true})
inclusion = loadCsv(surveyFiles[survey.id].inclusion, {typed: true})
```
